13. function Assert-True {
14.     param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)

16.         $failures.Add($Message)
17.     }
18. }
19. 
20. function Invoke-TaskForge {
21.     param([string[]]$Arguments)
22.     $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
23.     [pscustomobject]@{
24.         ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
25.         Output = ($output -join "`n")
26.     }
27. }

42.     Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
43.     Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'
44. 
45.     $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
46.     Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'
47. 
48.     $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
49.     Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
50.     Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'
51. 
52.     $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
53.     Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'
54. 
55.     $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
56.     Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'
57. 
58.     if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
59.         $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
60.         exit 1
61.     }
62.     "PASS: 8 base fixture assertions"
63. }
64. finally {
65.     Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
66. }
67.
